message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 25 cards + 8 special cards) | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play all cards in a single round). | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile; flip the top card to start the discard pile. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Gameplay** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top discard. If you cannot play, you must draw from the draw pile until you can play or the pile is empty. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and skips a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card you must shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player calls it before your next turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to get rid of all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points each
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each | | **Game End** | First player to reach 500 points (or agreed target) wins the game. | **Key Strategy Tips** 1. Keep a mix of colors so you’re not stuck with a single color when the discard pile changes. 2. Save Wild Draw Four for when you really need to block an opponent’s win. 3. Pay attention to what cards opponents are discarding; they might be holding onto certain numbers or colors. That’s the core of Uno—fast, colorful, and full of surprises!
